name: dsh-observer
description: Companion (follower) session for DSH. Listens to graft/session-transferred and rewrites its own pointer; never retired, never sliced.
notes: This package OWNS observer-bindings.json. dsh-graft-slice only announces transfers; it has no observer code.
The follower is never sliced: a transfer rewrites one pointer instead of creating a second tape, which is what keeps the pair deadlock-free.
